recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage-inspired album cover featuring a full-bleed background of light oak parquet flooring in a basketweave pattern, containing a small inset square portrait of a man in formal attire and three distinct levels of cream-colored typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured wood grain background vs. clean geometric inset portrait
Cream-colored typography vs. warm brown wood tones
Thin white border frame containing all visual elements
Asymmetrical balance between top-centered text and bottom-right portrait
coreInvariants: Thin white rectangular border inset from the edge
Square inset portrait occupying roughly 1/9th of the total area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small square portrait of a man in a tuxedo is positioned in the lower-right quadrant, scaled to fit within the parquet grid lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized display text in the upper center serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-center text, move down to the secondary text on the left, and finally rest on the portrait in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of the wood texture as negative space to emphasize the grid and grain.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blacks and whites (within the inset portrait)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, medium-value earth tones with high-value highlights in the text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text features a heavy inline or 'carved' effect to mimic wood inlay
Secondary text uses a clean, high-contrast slab serif
Tertiary text uses a small, all-caps geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main title letters have a rough, textured inner fill that suggests depth or wood carving
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic hierarchy using variations of slab serifs and a supporting sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure with internal detailing.
Appropriate for the secondary slab-serif metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution top-down view of a light oak parquet floor in a basketweave pattern. Include a thin white rectangular border inset slightly from the edges. Leave a square void in the lower-right quadrant for a portrait.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a square portrait of a man in a 1970s tuxedo in the lower-right void. Place three levels of cream-colored text in the upper half: a medium slab-serif name at the top, a large textured inline slab-serif title below it, and a small sans-serif block on the center-left.

verificationChecks: Is the wood grain texture visible through the display text?
Is the portrait perfectly square and aligned with the parquet grid?
Is the border a consistent thin white line?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Record label logo in bottom left
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the wood grain is not repetitive or AI-distorted.
Ensure the inline text effect looks like a physical inlay rather than a digital filter.
Verify the cream color is consistent across all text and the border.
Confirm the portrait lighting matches the warm tones of the wood.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [Wood Pattern] background, add a [Thin Border], place a [Square Portrait] in the lower right, and center [Textured Slab Serif] typography in the upper half using a [Cream] color palette.
